custom-sql.sql: SELECT CommercePriceList.* FROM CommercePriceList WHERE (CommercePriceList.expirationDate < ?) AND (CommercePriceList.expirationDate IS NOT NULL) AND ([$OWNER_USER_ID$] [$OWNER_USER_ID_AND_OR_CONNECTOR$] ([$STATUS$]))

SELECT DISTINCT CommercePriceList.* FROM CommercePriceList INNER JOIN CommercePriceListAccountRel ON CommercePriceListAccountRel.commercePriceListId = CommercePriceList.commercePriceListId WHERE (CommercePriceList.status = 0) AND (CommercePriceList.type_ = ?) AND (CommercePriceListAccountRel.commerceAccountId = ?) ORDER BY CommercePriceList.priority DESC

SELECT DISTINCT CommercePriceList.* FROM CommercePriceList INNER JOIN CommercePriceListAccountRel ON CommercePriceListAccountRel.commercePriceListId = CommercePriceList.commercePriceListId INNER JOIN CommercePriceListChannelRel ON CommercePriceListChannelRel.commercePriceListId = CommercePriceList.commercePriceListId WHERE (CommercePriceList.status = 0) AND (CommercePriceList.type_ = ?) AND (CommercePriceListAccountRel.commerceAccountId = ?) AND (CommercePriceListChannelRel.commerceChannelId = ?) ORDER BY CommercePriceList.priority DESC

SELECT DISTINCT CommercePriceList.* FROM CommercePriceList INNER JOIN CPLCommerceGroupAccountRel ON CPLCommerceGroupAccountRel.commercePriceListId = CommercePriceList.commercePriceListId WHERE (CommercePriceList.status = 0) AND (CommercePriceList.type_ = ?) AND (CPLCommerceGroupAccountRel.commerceAccountGroupId IN ([$ACCOUNT_GROUP_IDS$])) ORDER BY CommercePriceList.priority DESC

SELECT DISTINCT CommercePriceList.* FROM CommercePriceList INNER JOIN CPLCommerceGroupAccountRel ON CPLCommerceGroupAccountRel.commercePriceListId = CommercePriceList.commercePriceListId INNER JOIN CommercePriceListChannelRel ON CommercePriceListChannelRel.commercePriceListId = CommercePriceList.commercePriceListId WHERE (CommercePriceList.status = 0) AND (CommercePriceList.type_ = ?) AND (CPLCommerceGroupAccountRel.commerceAccountGroupId IN ([$ACCOUNT_GROUP_IDS$])) AND (CommercePriceListChannelRel.commerceChannelId = ?) ORDER BY CommercePriceList.priority DESC

SELECT DISTINCT CommercePriceList.* FROM CommercePriceList INNER JOIN CommercePriceListChannelRel ON CommercePriceListChannelRel.commercePriceListId = CommercePriceList.commercePriceListId WHERE (CommercePriceList.status = 0) AND (CommercePriceList.type_ = ?) AND (CommercePriceListChannelRel.commerceChannelId = ?) ORDER BY CommercePriceList.priority DESC

SELECT DISTINCT CommercePriceList.* FROM CommercePriceList LEFT JOIN CommercePriceListAccountRel ON CommercePriceListAccountRel.commercePriceListId = CommercePriceList.commercePriceListId LEFT JOIN CPLCommerceGroupAccountRel ON CPLCommerceGroupAccountRel.commercePriceListId = CommercePriceList.commercePriceListId LEFT JOIN CommercePriceListChannelRel ON CommercePriceListChannelRel.commercePriceListId = CommercePriceList.commercePriceListId WHERE (CommercePriceList.status = 0) AND (CommercePriceList.type_ = ?) AND (CommercePriceListAccountRel.commercePriceListAccountRelId IS NULL) AND (CPLCommerceGroupAccountRel.cPLCommerceAccountGroupRelId IS NULL) AND (CommercePriceListChannelRel.commercePriceListChannelRelId IS NULL) ORDER BY CommercePriceList.priority DESC

SELECT DISTINCT CommercePriceEntry.* FROM CommercePriceEntry INNER JOIN CommercePriceList ON CommercePriceList.commercePriceListId = CommercePriceEntry.commercePriceListId LEFT JOIN CommercePriceListAccountRel ON CommercePriceListAccountRel.commercePriceListId = CommercePriceEntry.commercePriceListId LEFT JOIN CPLCommerceGroupAccountRel ON CPLCommerceGroupAccountRel.commercePriceListId = CommercePriceEntry.commercePriceListId LEFT JOIN CommercePriceListChannelRel ON CommercePriceListChannelRel.commercePriceListId = CommercePriceEntry.commercePriceListId WHERE (CommercePriceList.status = 0) AND (CommercePriceList.type_ = ?) AND (CommercePriceEntry.CPInstanceUuid = ?) AND ( ( (CommercePriceListAccountRel.commerceAccountId = ?) OR (CPLCommerceGroupAccountRel.commerceAccountGroupId IN ([$ACCOUNT_GROUP_IDS$])) OR (CommercePriceListChannelRel.commerceChannelId = ?) ) OR ( (CommercePriceListAccountRel.commercePriceListAccountRelId IS NULL) AND (CPLCommerceGroupAccountRel.cPLCommerceAccountGroupRelId IS NULL) AND (CommercePriceListChannelRel.commercePriceListChannelRelId IS NULL) ) ) ORDER BY CommercePriceEntry.price ASC
